go 1.27

-- g/dep/dep.go --
package gdep

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func Name() string {
	_ = os.Getpid()
	if strings.HasPrefix("std-ok", "std") {
		return "std-ok"
	}
	return "bad"
}

-- l/dep/exec_plan9.go --
package ldep

import "os"

func init() {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		os.StartProcess("/bin/true", nil, &os.ProcAttr{})
	}
}

-- l/dep/ghost_windows.go --
package ldep

import "example.com/ghost"

func init() { ghost.Run() }
